stem.text: Which statement about vector quantities is correct?

A.text: Acceleration of free fall is a vector quantity because it has a constant magnitude.

B.text: Temperature in ${}^{\circ}\text{C}$ is a vector quantity because it can be positive or negative.

C.text: Time is a vector quantity because it can only go in the forwards direction.

D.text: Weight is a vector quantity because it has a direction.
